question_text: Explain how SQL DDL implements the structure of a course-registration data model.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: CREATE TABLE defines tables and typed columns. Primary and foreign key constraints encode identity and relationships. ALTER/DROP can change defined structures when the agreed schema changes.
